inputs.systemMessage:
You are a query routing and synthesis assistant.

Your responsibilities are to:

1. Understand the user's intent.
2. Select the appropriate tool or combination of tools.
3. Formulate effective retrieval queries.
4. Synthesize tool outputs into a complete answer.

You do not rely on your own knowledge. Use available tools to gather information and base all responses on tool outputs.

Available tools:

* policy_retriever: governance policies, thresholds, definitions, eligibility criteria, restrictions, and response procedures.
* data_retriever: supplier records, performance metrics, spend, PO values, supplier tiers, risk indicators, disruptions, defects, and operational data.

Tool selection:

* Use policy_retriever for questions about rules, definitions, thresholds, limits, eligibility criteria, or policy interpretation.
* Use data_retriever for questions about suppliers, metrics, counts, rankings, averages, totals, trends, or records.
* Use both tools when a question requires supplier data to be evaluated against a policy.

Retrieval rules:

* Construct retrieval queries that capture the full user intent.
* Include all relevant entities, metrics, filters, conditions, and comparisons.
* Retrieve all information needed to answer the question in as few tool calls as possible.

Answering:

* Base responses only on tool results.
* Do not invent facts, policies, thresholds, or supplier data.
* If information is unavailable, state that clearly.
* Provide concise, direct answers.

inputs.name: policy_retriever
inputs.description:
Use this tool to look up governance rules, policy thresholds, compliance requirements, contractual definitions, and procedural guidelines from the supplier policy document.

Use this when the question involves:
- Classification rules, tier definitions, or eligibility criteria
- Performance thresholds, limits, or minimum requirements
- Penalty, incentive, or rebate program conditions
- Risk definitions, escalation procedures, or response protocols
- Audit requirements, scoring methodology, or overdue classifications
- Certification requirements or sustainability standards
- Concentration limits, diversification rules, or alternate supplier conditions
- Any "what does the policy say about X" type question

data.label: Chatflow Tool
data.name: ChatflowTool
data.description: Use as a tool to execute another chatflow

inputParams.label: Tool Description
inputParams.name: description
inputParams.description: Description of what the tool does. This is for LLM to determine when to use this tool.
inputParams.placeholder: State of the Union QA - useful for when you need to ask questions about the most recent state of the union address.

inputParams.label: Override Config
inputParams.name: overrideConfig
inputParams.description: Override the config passed to the Chatflow.

inputParams.label: Base URL
inputParams.name: baseURL
inputParams.description: Base URL to Flowise. By default, it is the URL of the incoming request. Useful when you need to execute the Chatflow through an alternative route.

inputParams.label: Start new session per message
inputParams.name: startNewSession
inputParams.description: Whether to continue the session with the Chatflow tool or start a new one with each interaction. Useful for Chatflows with memory if you want to avoid it.

inputParams.label: Use Question from Chat
inputParams.name: useQuestionFromChat
inputParams.description: Whether to use the question from the chat as input to the chatflow. If turned on, this will override the custom input.

inputParams.label: Custom Input
inputParams.name: customInput
inputParams.description: Custom input to be passed to the chatflow. Leave empty to let LLM decides the input.

inputs.name: data_retriever
inputs.description:
Use this tool to query supplier purchase order and performance data.

Use this when the question involves:
- Looking up, filtering, or listing specific suppliers and their attributes
- Calculating totals, averages, counts, or rankings from the data
- Comparing performance metrics across suppliers, regions, or categories
- Identifying suppliers that meet or breach a particular threshold
- Aggregating financial, operational, or compliance data by any dimension
- Any question requiring actual numbers, names, or records from the dataset

outputAnchors.name: ChatflowTool
outputAnchors.label: ChatflowTool
outputAnchors.description: Use as a tool to execute another chatflow

inputParams.name: thinkingLevel
inputParams.description: Adjust the amount of reasoning effort based on the complexity of the user request

inputParams.label: Top Next Highest Probability Tokens

inputParams.description: Decode using top-k sampling: consider the set of top_k most probable tokens. Must be positive

inputParams.label: Safety Settings
inputParams.name: safetySettings
inputParams.description: Safety settings for the model. Refer to the official guide on how to use Safety Settings

options.label: Dangerous
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT
options.description: Promotes, facilitates, or encourages harmful acts.

options.label: Harassment
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT
options.description: Negative or harmful comments targeting identity and/or protected attributes.

options.label: Hate Speech
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH
options.description: Content that is rude, disrespectful, or profane.

options.label: Sexually Explicit
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT
options.description: Contains references to sexual acts or other lewd content.

options.label: None
options.name: BLOCK_NONE
options.description: Always show regardless of probability of unsafe content

options.label: Only High
options.name: BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH
options.description: Block when high probability of unsafe content

options.label: Medium and Above
options.name: BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE
options.description: Block when medium or high probability of unsafe content

options.label: Low and Above
options.name: BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE
options.description: Block when low, medium or high probability of unsafe content

options.label: Threshold Unspecified (Default Threshold)
options.name: HARM_BLOCK_THRESHOLD_UNSPECIFIED
options.description: Threshold is unspecified, block using default threshold

inputParams.name: baseUrl
inputParams.description: Base URL for the API. Leave empty to use the default.
